<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/post-showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Posts shown off. Axes: layout (intro: four small post cards beside the intro with a view-all link, featured:
  the first post in detail beside its picture, overlay: cards with the text over the picture), cols (2, 3:
  overlay columns), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Post, PostLabels } from "./post-card.types";
  import type { HeadLink } from "../components/section-frame.types";

  export type PostShowcaseProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    posts: Post[];
    labels: PostLabels;
    action: HeadLink;
    layout?: "intro" | "featured" | "overlay";
    cols?: "2" | "3";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Link from "../primitives/link/link.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import PostFeature from "../components/post-feature.svelte";
  import PostMiniCard from "../components/post-mini-card.svelte";
  import PostOverlayCard from "../components/post-overlay-card.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    posts,
    labels,
    action,
    layout = "intro",
    cols = "3",
    mediaSide = "start",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PostShowcaseProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "intro")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    <Link href={action.href} size="sm" data-testid="section-action">
      {action.label}
      <LucideIcon name="arrow-right" size={16} />
    </Link>
    {#snippet aside()}
      <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        {#each posts as p, i (p.id)}
          {#if (i < 4)}
            <PostMiniCard p={p} labels={labels} />
          {/if}
        {/each}
      </Box>
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{:else if ((layout as string) === "featured")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
    landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
  >
    {#each posts as p, i (p.id)}
      {#if (i < 1)}
        <PostFeature p={p} labels={labels} />
      {/if}
    {/each}
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{:else}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} heading={{ badge }} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
    <Box
      class={
        (cols as string) === "2" ? "grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"
        : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-3"
      }
    >
      {#each posts as p, i (p.id)}
        {#if (i < (((cols as string) === "2") ? 2 : 3))}
          <PostOverlayCard p={p} labels={labels} ratio={(((cols as string) === "2") ? "16/9" : "4/3")} />
        {/if}
      {/each}
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
